title: Above their department average
prompt: Return the names of employees who earn more than the average salary of their own department (use a correlated subquery).
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE emp6 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, department TEXT, salary INTEGER); INSERT INTO emp6 VALUES (1,'A','Eng',90000),(2,'B','Eng',60000),(3,'C','Sales',70000),(4,'D','Sales',50000),(5,'E','Eng',100000);
reference_sql: SELECT e1.name FROM emp6 e1 WHERE e1.salary > (SELECT AVG(e2.salary) FROM emp6 e2 WHERE e2.department = e1.department);
